findings.title: Pass the injected Archive identifier through source interpretation
findings.description: The new identifier controls all direct unit_document URLs, but the final apply_source_encoding call does not receive it. The commentary_pages branch in source_encoding.py:245 builds each note-page facs using b.IDENTIFIER, silently retaining the first-day scan. This affects witnesses with paginated source commentary and violates volume-specific provenance.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic ExplicitScanEditionTests.unit with citations.en=[{scan:s7,text:ab,note_type:commentary}] and source_encoding.en.commentary_pages=[{target:unit.urn,fragments:[{scan:s7,printed_page:1,text:a},{scan:s8,printed_page:2,text:b}]}], rendered with identifier=another-archive-item and custom header/projects. Note markers point to first-day item; body markers correctly point to another-archive-item.
findings.fix: Pass identifier through apply_source_encoding and use it for commentary page URLs, retaining the existing default; add this synthetic case to the new tests.
